title: Tab5 Touch_ST7123 ghost contacts after a polling pause: code-level review

hardware.reason: No Tab5 attached to this workspace; physical reproduction and soak were not performed.

firmware.target: M5Stack Tab5, ST7121 panel, touch FW version 01

execution.virtual_device: NOT RUN: the local Tab5 emulator has no ST7123 controller-level model

checks.name: M5GFX Touch_ST7123 source review
checks.details: No area/intensity/duration filter; intensity byte discarded; INT pin unused; no register writes or reset.

checks.name: 0.2.28 vs 0.3.0 getTouchRaw comparison
checks.details: Function body identical; only the .cpp to .inl layout changed.

checks.name: M5Unified press-path review
checks.details: First pressed frame enters touch_begin; TOUCH_MIN_UPDATE_MSEC is 4 ms; no debounce.

checks.name: host-side parse reproduction with the reporter's field values
checks.details: Shipped logic returns the two edge points; area+intensity rule returns 0; real tap survives.

checks.name: physical Tab5 reproduction, soak and temperature variation
single-transaction read and INT-gated read experiments
touch firmware version availability and update path
checks.details: No public information found; requires M5Stack confirmation.

checks.name: upstream comment
checks.details: Posted one English comment at https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/issues/418#issuecomment-6904885353; issue left open, no code pushed.

checks.name: protocol §6.6 With Coord clear condition extraction
checks.details: ST7123 TDDI Interface Protocol V01.11 p.18-19: reading the last register of the last supported coordinate clears INT and the With Coord bit.

checks.name: ack address coverage in both read modes (10 touches -> 0x0059)
checks.details: stock: 70 B from 0x0014; single: 74 B from 0x0010; both end at 0x0059.

checks.name: With Coord cleared after a burst on device
checks.details: Author measured adv_info=0x08 after 10/10 bursts in both read modes while INT cleared; conflicts with §6.6c; device-side measurement, not reproduced here.

checks.name: two consecutive ghost frames are separate controller frames
checks.details: Author measured INT high-then-low between frames in 7/7 cases; bytes differed in 5/7; excludes re-serve and torn reads.

checks.name: real-touch raw table near x=0 / x=719
adv_info after 10 s idle
checks.details: Would separate a per-frame status byte from a latch that never clears.

checks.name: upstream follow-up comment
checks.details: Posted one English comment at https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/issues/418#issuecomment-6908007729; issue left open, no code pushed.

notes: Read-only review: no M5GFX/M5Unified change, no push to the upstream repository, no issue close.
Host parse results are not device validation.
The reporter's ghost statistics are quoted as their measurements, not reproduced here.
Round 2 adds the author's INT/frame trace and a protocol §6.6 cross-check; no hardware or virtual-device run here.

followups.summary: 作者补充逐帧 INT 电平、两种读取模式的 burst 原始帧与 burst 后 adv_info；结合协议 §6.6 复核后，排除重复供给与跨帧撕裂，修正 with_coord 判据，并把鬼点几何由“同一行”改为“两端钳位”。
